selected_runtime_identity_limits: Explicit coordinator-selected Astra visual-inspection role. Independent resolved/backend model identity is not exposed or attested by this inspection.
method: Exactly eight original 640x480 PNGs were emitted and actually viewed using view_image original. Visual estimates at horizontal center x approximately 320 (near-center band 312–328). boundary_y is approximately zero-based; floor height is 480 minus boundary_y. Soft boundary and slight slope warrant ±2 px uncertainty. No evaluator distance, threshold or classifier data was read or used.

viewed.ambiguity: Soft boundary transition limits exact row assignment; no material central occlusion.

findings.stock: Center floor strip estimates 22 px post-3 and 23 px idle-4; difference is within visual uncertainty.

findings.angular_reference: Both selected images have approximately 21 px center floor strip.

findings.scope: These are selected still-image appearances only. No success, threshold, continuous jitter, causal or reliability conclusion is made.

limitations: Visual measurements are approximate, not pixel-classifier measurements.
No physical distance, force, control performance or causal inference.
Two stills per variant cannot prove continuous jitter or stability.
No evaluator/classifier results, source files or unrelated images were inspected.
Filenames identify viewed files but were not treated as proof of behavior.
No app/model action, repository edit or canonical-record edit; only the authorized fresh result JSON was written.
